attchmntText: CESC Limited has informed the Exchange that the Company has fixed Record Date as October 31, 2018 for the purpose of determining the eligible shareholders of the Company entitled to receive the said equity shares of RP-SG Retail Limited and RP-SG Business Process Services Limited.

CESC Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Further to our letter No. SEC: 12355 dated 12 October, 2018, please find enclosed a copy of newspaper publication as published today, in Business Standard (all editions) and Aajkal.'.
CESC Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated October 12, 2018, titled "Composite Scheme of Arrangement".

CESC Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Intimation of outcome of the meeting of the Board of Directors of CESC Limited ("Company") held on 12 October 2018 and disclosures under Regulation 30 the SEBI (Listing Obligations andDisclosure Requirements) Regulations 2015, as amended.'.

CESC Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'We enclose a copy of an advertisement as published today in Business Standard and Aajkal, in respect of a notice to the shareholders in relation to transfer of equity shares to Investors Education and Protection Fund.'.

Significant increase in volume has been observed in CESC Limited. The Exchange, in order to ensure that investors have latest relevant information about the company and to inform the market place so that the interest of the investors is safeguarded, had written to the company. CESC Limited has submitted their response.

The Exchange, in order to ensure that investors have latest relevant information about the company and to inform the market place so that the interest of the investors is safeguarded, has written to the company. The response from the company is awaited.

CESC Limited has informed the Exchange that This is to inform you that the Registrar of Companies, Kolkata has approved an extension of time for holding the Fortieth Annual General Meeting of the Company by a period of three months i.e. upto December 31, 2018 for the financial year ended on March 31, 2018.
